sentences.en: Mary was annoyed with Tom's use of colloquialisms.
sentences.zh: 玛丽对汤姆使用的口语表达感到不满。

sentences.en: He uses too many colloquialisms in his writing, making it hard to understand.
sentences.zh: 他在写作中使用了太多的口语表达，让人难以理解。

sentences.en: The teacher advised us to avoid colloquialism when we write essays.
sentences.zh: 老师建议我们在写作文时避免使用口语化的表达。
